versions.subject: Merge PR #5501 from @0xFustang - FileFix - Suspicious Sub-processes Spawned by Web Browsers
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\chrome.exe'
        - '\msedge.exe'
        - '\firefox.exe'
        - '\brave.exe'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\regsvr32.exe'
        - '\bitsadmin.exe'
        - '\certutil.exe'
        - '\mshta.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '#'
condition: selection
